title: Provider factory returns valid LanguageModelV3 instance
steps: Call createCodexConsumer with modelId, jwt, accountId
Inspect returned object for specificationVersion, provider, modelId
expected_result: Returns object with specificationVersion='v3', provider='codex-consumer', modelId='gpt-4o'

title: doStream POSTs to correct ChatGPT consumer API endpoint
steps: Capture the URL sent to fetch
expected_result: POST to https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/responses

title: doStream sends all required headers
steps: Construct provider with known jwt and accountId
expected_result: Headers include: Authorization='Bearer test-jwt', chatgpt-account-id='acct-456', originator='pi', OpenAI-Beta='responses=experimental', accept='text/event-stream', Content-Type='application/json'

title: doStream constructs correct request body
test_data: Prompt with system message and user message
steps: Call doStream with prompt containing system + user messages
expected_result: Body contains: model='gpt-4o', store=false, stream=true, instructions (system prompt text), input (user messages), text.verbosity='low', include=['reasoning.encrypted_content']

title: SSE response.output_text.delta maps to text-delta stream part
steps: Create mock SSE stream with response.output_text.delta event
expected_result: Stream emits {type:'text-delta', id:..., delta:'Hello'}

title: SSE response.reasoning_text.delta maps to reasoning-delta stream part
steps: Create mock SSE stream with response.reasoning_text.delta event
expected_result: Stream emits {type:'reasoning-delta', id:..., delta:'thinking...'}

title: SSE response.function_call_arguments.delta maps to tool-input-delta
steps: Create mock SSE stream with function_call_arguments.delta event
Call doStream with appropriate tool config
expected_result: Stream emits {type:'tool-input-delta', id:..., delta:'{\"path\":"}'}

title: SSE response.output_item.done for function_call maps to tool-call stream part
preconditions: Previous tool-input-delta events have streamed arguments
steps: Create mock SSE with function_call_arguments.delta then output_item.done
expected_result: Final stream part is {type:'tool-call', toolCallId:'call_1', toolName:'read', input:...}

title: SSE response.completed maps to finish stream part with usage
steps: Create mock SSE stream ending with response.completed event
expected_result: Final part is {type:'finish', usage:{inputTokens:{total:10,...}, outputTokens:{total:20,...}}, finishReason:{unified:'stop',raw:'completed'}}

title: SSE response.done maps to finish stream part
steps: Create mock SSE stream ending with response.done event
expected_result: Final part is {type:'finish', finishReason:...}

title: SSE response.incomplete maps to finish with length reason
steps: Create mock SSE stream ending with response.incomplete event
expected_result: Final part has finishReason.unified='length'

title: SSE response.failed maps to error stream part
steps: Create mock SSE stream with response.failed event
expected_result: Stream emits {type:'error', error:...} or stream errors

title: Retry on 429 with exponential backoff
steps: Set up mock that returns 429 for first 2 calls, then valid SSE on 3rd
expected_result: Fetch called 3 times; exponential delay between retries

title: Retry on 5xx with exponential backoff
steps: Set up mock that returns 503 for first call, then valid SSE on 2nd
expected_result: Fetch called 2 times; succeeds on retry

title: Gives up after max retries exceeded
steps: Set up mock that always returns 429
expected_result: Fetch called 3 times (initial + 2 retries); final error thrown

title: Non-retryable HTTP errors fail immediately
expected_result: Single fetch call; error thrown immediately without retry

title: Malformed SSE data produces error
preconditions: Mock fetch returns SSE with non-JSON data
steps: Create mock SSE with invalid JSON data line
expected_result: Stream errors or emits error-type part

title: Empty SSE stream completes without error
preconditions: Mock fetch returns empty SSE stream (just [DONE] or EOF)
steps: Create mock that returns empty body
expected_result: Stream closes cleanly, possibly with a finish event

title: Multiple user/assistant messages mapped to input array
test_data: Prompt: system + user + assistant + user messages
expected_result: input array contains all messages in order; system message becomes instructions

title: Network errors are surfaced correctly
steps: Set up mock that throws TypeError
expected_result: doStream rejects with the network error
